cohort: 515 neonates and mothers (175 cases with HIE and 340 controls without HIE)
finding: Neonates born to illiterate women, those who experienced prolonged labour, those whose mothers did not have ultrasound checkups during pregnancy, those delivered by caesarean section, and those born preterm or post-term were more likely to develop hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with an increased incidence of HIE.
gest_age: Preterm and post-term birth were associated with HIE
